orderRef.description: The order whose lines are being consolidated; also stamped as the resulting PACK task's `orderRef`. Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

lineId.description: The line arriving at Rebin with this call. Must be a member of the order's required line set (else 422 `rebin-unknown-line`). Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

requiredLineIds.description: Every line id the order needs before it can be packed. Required and non-empty on every call, but only the FIRST call for an `orderRef` uses it — it fixes the order's required set, and later calls' values are ignored (send the same set each time).

items.description: A null item is accepted and treated as an empty line id string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).

packCpt.description: Critical Pull Time for the PACK task this order's consolidation creates. Used only by the arrival that completes the set.

packRequiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities a station must hold to claim the resulting PACK task (open, freeform list — see CreateTaskRequest.requiredCapabilities). Required and non-empty on every call; used only by the arrival that completes the set.

items.description: A null item is accepted and treated as an empty capability string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).

packFragile.description: Packing hint carried onto the resulting PACK task's `fragile`. Optional; omission and an explicit null both mean false.

packGiftWrap.description: Packing hint carried onto the resulting PACK task's `giftWrap`. Optional; omission and an explicit null both mean false.
